repo_notes.content: @fianto/solana-payments is a TypeScript library on @solana/kit. It builds USDC payment transactions and Solana Subscriptions program transactions, and validates the signed transactions a wallet returns before they are broadcast or co-signed. Entry points: src/index.ts (package root), src/subscriptions/index.ts (/subscriptions) and src/money/index.ts (/money). Tests sit beside their sources as *.test.ts. Runnable examples are in examples/. README.md is the user guide.

Validators (validateSignedPayment, validateSignedSubscribe, validateSignedPayerAction, verifyCoSignedTransaction) return { ok: true } or { ok: false, reason } and never throw. Each reason is a string literal in a union type next to the function, e.g. PaymentValidationFailure in src/payment-transaction.ts. Amounts are bigint base units.

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: What the library does, its three entry points, peer dependencies and runtime support (README.md, package.json).

pages.title: One-time USDC payments
pages.purpose: buildPaymentTransaction and validateSignedPayment in src/payment-transaction.ts: the transaction layout, the expectation object and every refusal reason.

pages.title: Co-signed transactions
pages.purpose: verifyCoSignedTransaction in src/co-signed-transaction.ts and the account-list and signer-role checks in validateSignedSubscribe.

pages.title: Wallet signatures and Sign-In With Solana
pages.purpose: verifyWalletSignature in src/wallet-signature.ts (forgeable key rejection) and renderSiwsMessage, siwsChainId and nonceOfSiwsMessage in src/siws.ts.

pages.title: Subscriptions
pages.purpose: The /subscriptions entry point in src/subscriptions/: plan, subscribe, charge and payer-action transactions, account decoders, address derivation and program errors.

pages.title: Money
pages.purpose: The /money entry point in src/money/: USDC and SOL bigint parsing and formatting, basis-point fees and percent formatting.

pages.title: RPC and token-account helpers
pages.purpose: RPC failure classification (src/rpc-transport-failure.ts, src/preflight-failure.ts, src/transaction-errors.ts), associated token addresses, token-account reads and AccountBatcher.
